prompt.alinti: Comment "BUILD" and I'll send you all 5 repo links 🛠️
these are the 5 repos i install in every single Claude project. no exceptions.

i'm talking about @Claude here, specifically Claude Code for dev work. every new project starts the same way for me now: vibe-tandem, n8n-mcp, opcode, ccstatusline, and hooks-mastery go in before I write a single line.

but here's where it gets crazy — most people building with Claude are doing it completely raw. no hooks, no status tracking, no MCP layer. that's the difference between an amateur setup and a pro one.

n8n-mcp | Connects Claude to n8n. It builds, wires and runs real automation workflows for you, with 500+ nodes it actually understands, czlonkowski/n8n-mcp | AMCP for Claude Desktop / Claude Code / Windows

opcode | A desktop GUI for Claude Code (formerly Claudia). Manage sessions, projects, usage and custom agents in one window, no terminal juggling. winfunc/opcode | A powerful GUI app and Toolkit for Claude Code. Create custom agents, manage interactive Claude Code sessions, run secure.

ccstatusline | A live statusline in Claude Code. See your model, token cost and how much context is left at a glance, fully customizable. sirmalloc/ Beautiful highly customizable statusline for Claude Code CLI with powerline support, themes and more.
hooks-mastery | Master Claude Code hooks. Fire your own scripts on every tool call to format, lint, log or block risky actions automatically.
